stories.title: Update pom.xml to Spring Boot 3.2.5
stories.description: Replace Red Hat BOM with Spring Boot 3.2.5 parent POM. Update Java source/target to 17. Update Spring Cloud Kubernetes to use 2023.0.x BOM with fabric8 variant. Update maven-compiler-plugin to 3.11.0. Update kubernetes-maven-plugin to 1.16.2. Remove explicit spring-boot-maven-plugin version (inherited from parent). Remove Red Hat artifact repositories.
acceptanceCriteria: Java source and target set to 17
No Red Hat BOM or repositories

stories.title: Migrate javax.persistence to jakarta.persistence
stories.description: Update all Java source files using javax.persistence imports to use jakarta.persistence. Specifically Product.java uses javax.persistence.Entity, javax.persistence.Id, and javax.persistence.Table - all must be updated to jakarta.persistence.*.

stories.title: Update application configuration for Spring Boot 3 and H2 2.x
stories.description: Update application.properties to add Spring Boot 3 actuator endpoint exposure config. Verify H2 URL compatibility with H2 2.x bundled in Spring Boot 3. Add spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto if needed. Ensure Spring Cloud Kubernetes config loading is disabled for local development.
acceptanceCriteria: H2 datasource URL compatible with H2 2.x
spring.cloud.kubernetes.enabled=false present or JVM arg retained

stories.title: Refactor CatalogController to use constructor injection
stories.description: Replace @Autowired field injection in CatalogController with constructor injection. Remove @Autowired annotation from the ProductRepository field. Add a constructor that accepts ProductRepository as a parameter. This is a best practice recommended for Spring Boot 3 and makes the class easier to test.

stories.title: Build verification and smoke test
stories.description: Run full Maven build with mvn clean package -DskipTests to verify the complete project compiles and packages correctly. Verify the application starts by running mvn spring-boot:run briefly and checking the /api/catalog and /actuator/health endpoints respond. Document final migration status.
acceptanceCriteria: No ERROR messages in startup log
